statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and I49.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The purpose is to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The submitted materials do not align with the records currently maintained in the insurer's system
